from pathlib import Path
import json,shutil,tempfile
from experiments.arithmetic_dse.step2_evidence import verify,ROOT
current=verify()
assert current['status']=='passed' and not current['current_source_mismatches']
freeze=json.loads((ROOT/'experiments/arithmetic/step2_freeze_v4.json').read_text())
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='step2-isolated-') as directory:
 root=Path(directory)
 names=['experiments/arithmetic/step2_freeze_v4.json','experiments/arithmetic/evidence/step2_v2','experiments/arithmetic/backend_usage.json',*freeze['historical_freezes']]
 for name in names:
  source=ROOT/name;target=root/name;target.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
  if source.is_dir(): shutil.copytree(source,target)
  else: shutil.copy2(source,target)
 assert not (root/'build').exists()
 isolated=verify(root)
 assert isolated['status']=='passed' and isolated['verification_scope']=='frozen_source_snapshot_only'
print(json.dumps({'current':current,'isolated_status':isolated['status'],'isolated_has_build':False},indent=2))
